DOCS SUCCESSOR CANDIDATE READY — cand-2PR0D25C514364KEKA0MYM6ZXQ, exact commit 9005320c21cbdb435489a030b23ca2dec84015c0, parent/base 1cb64bd39f097c32233a52ff6e167f9f93d9d127, canonical-repository branch scout/docs-successor-v2. Path policy is docs-site only. docs-site tree 91a82357366f792a83d1259be4b42e808c722f4d; 43 files, +2649/-322. main remains e584ad6.

WHAT THE READER GETS. The landing page now answers what the library does in ordinary prose. Seven executable task guides cover source inspection, story modeling, recall representation, public alignment, support-aware summary, Birthday Interview scoring, canonical persistence, and embedding features/policy (the alignment page is the shared complete comparison). Every new program was compiled and run through public API. Captured output is file-bound by SHA and names the exact producer revision. Four accessible source-derived figures show posterior source/external mass, estimate/support/missingness, sentence-14 context nesting, and interview categories/resolution/profile. The conceptual pages were rewritten to remove the user-flagged “refuse to collapse”, “not X but Y”, “not optional metadata”, and slogan headings.

COLLAB FINDINGS CLOSED. Producer revisions are explicit; ModelAStory now prints context parents; the context figure is parsed from the two exact sentence-14 records and carries the exact source sentence; every visible interview label and its accessible description derive from parsed output; a coherent output mutation rebuilds the page and changes visible resolution/profile labels; interval prose states modal-only lower versus any-positive-mass upper. Save/deliver uses StoryModelCodec only. The added embedding guide shows deterministic observed plus Missing per-item outcomes, a plain local receipt, raw/purpose denials, and one authorized sanitized keyed request; it makes no quality claim.

EXACT CLEAN CANDIDATE GATE. `npm run verify` EXIT 0: Astro check 18 files, 0 errors/warnings/hints; static build 17 pages; verbatim artifact 1726 bytes and SHA-256 62f03a03ed09c4fe4beeeb3ec5b0b4d8fe34bac0c411983a41e7101621582ba1; all alignment/summary/context/interview render and mutation courts pass; provenance court 11/11 including clean positive control, dirty tracked mutation, restore, lying revision rejection, and matching revision acceptance. Figure-data SHA-256: alignment 16ad21d8187b306577afb3c3f6a8e41f83f0e3e2af37fbfd8cc7340bae4138c7; summary 8cdc34b8dbf02b7078e8375414179d5b52cbb3c3dba4440aa7792d6354dacc9c; context 1344ee723cb9da17a8498c5d14a05780fa793dc1113b2160cc7a1e20ea17a9c6; interview bb11e8b1be803214c3db45bdc2332fb713c0585f09ce5f31c3dff5c502f698f2. All seven new Scala example files pass repository Scalafmt when injected into coreJVM/embedCoreJVM/fixturesJVM. Repository `scalafmtCheckAll` ran LAST at 9005320, EXIT 0. Git status clean and diff-check clean after every mutation court restored.

LIMITS RECORDED, NOT HIDDEN. The in-app browser was unavailable; the installed Playwright runner lacked its isolated Chromium binary; user Chrome was left untouched under AGENTS. Screenshot QA is unclaimed. The mandated reference-scope command itself exits 1 with no output on this docs candidate: trace shows docs-site/examples/PublicAlignAndInterpret.scala yields one uppercase type, then a later @main-only file makes git-show|grep|awk nonzero under set -euo pipefail before the script prints scope. I recorded the exact failure on the bead and do not treat blank output as evidence. Changed paths remain docs-site only; the direct docs court and executable-example checks above are the scoped gate.

GOVERNANCE. Required reviewer is codex-storymodel-collab; authorizer is claude-storymodel4s. New row currently has two ancestor blockers plus review/authorization. I attempted to supersede and then abandon my old cand-163 row; both were rejected because that row was proposed from the vanished standalone repository identity, while this corrected successor was proposed from canonical. cand-5NFB is the separate intermediate custody row. Chief/m1 must retire those records; I will not fabricate same-repository ancestry or authorization. No merge, push, or landing action taken.
